description:
About Faire

Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

About this role

Faire's quality, depth, and breadth of brands is its strongest value to retailers. Our Brand Partnerships team is at the forefront of Faire's success, ensuring that the best and most relevant brands join and thrive on our platform.

As a Account Executive (L2B), you will be a trusted advisor to Upmarket brands across Spain, helping them unlock wholesale growth on Faire and driving incremental GMV at scale.

This role is a blend of strategic thinking and high-velocity sales execution. You will own a portfolio of brands across your geos, proactively identifying and activating the best-fit brands for Faire. You bring a strong commercial mindset  comfortable from C-level to operational stakeholder and you use AI, data, and sharp instincts to outperform.

We are looking for a stellar performer: someone who has finished top 3 in their org, qualified for President's Club or All-Stars, and is hungry to do it again in a market that is genuinely early and genuinely exciting.

You're excited about this opportunity because...

  • You have been top of the leaderboard before and you want to do it in a market that isn't fully built yet, where your territory becomes the foundation others inherit
  • You are energised by fast-moving, ambiguous environments and see AI as a genuine force multiplier, not a buzzword
  • You want to sell something that actually matters, levelling the playing field for independent retailers against e-commerce and big-box giants is a mission you can get behind
  • You want to work alongside a tight-knit team of high performers who share wins loudly, debug losses together, and hold themselves to a standard most sales teams only talk about
  • You are curious by default, you dig until you understand, and you bring that intellectual rigour to every deal

What You'll Do

Identify and win the right opportunities

  • Manage a book of business across Spain with the goal of maximizing the incremental GMV that new Upmarket brands bring to the Faire platform
  • Set your own sub-targets, hold yourself accountable, and know exactly what levers to pull when performance is under pressure
  • Use business data, category insights, AI-powered tooling, and your own market knowledge to build a pipeline that is both high volume and high quality
  • Support new brands through their first quarter on Faire, ensuring they understand the platform and are set up to receive orders and grow

Lead a best-in-class upmarket sales cycle

  • Lead every customer interaction with a personalized, insight-led approach, understanding each brand's unique business and shaping Faire's value proposition to their specific problems
  • Navigate multi-threaded deals with confidence: from C-suite vision conversations to operational onboarding with sales and marketing teams
  • Develop tailored onboarding plans that balance near-term activation with long-term platform success
  • Make independent, well-reasoned decisions on when to advance a deal and when to pass, and own the outcome either way
  • Stay resilient and input-focused when performance is challenging; model the standard for the team

Be the expert on your markets

  • Be solution-oriented to common objections and geo-specific blockers, size the opportunity, identify what's needed, and act on it with product and leadership
  • Understand how competitors and industry players operate and articulate Faire's key differentiators with precision
  • Research trends, industry events, and key account signals across Spain, and bring that intelligence back to sharpen team strategy

Represent Faire across the wholesale industry

  • Drive Faire's value props and messaging across the full sales surface: outreach, nurture, tradeshows, events, and in-person brand visits
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities that drive incremental revenue for the platform
  • Develop content and host webinars to engage leads in your verticals and share onboarding best practices
  • Collaborate with marketing to shape top-of-funnel messaging across paid, web, and nurture channels

What we're looking for

Must haves

  • Spanish Native
  • Proven track record of exSpainding quota at upmarket level, top 3 in your org, President's Club / All-Stars qualifier
  • High-velocity pipeline engine: ability to run multiple complex Upmarket deals simultaneously without sacrificing quality
  • Sharp executive presence, comfortable operating from C-level to operational stakeholder
  • AI fluency: you use AI tools daily to prospect, prep, and accelerate, not as a talking point but as a genuine lever
  • Intellectual curiosity, you ask better questions, dig deeper, and find the unlock others miss
  • Mission alignment: you believe in independent retail and can articulate why Faire matters

Nice to haves

  • Any other European language skills
  • Background in wholesale, retail, or brand partnerships
  • Experience with Salesforce, Clay, or AI sales tooling

Salary Range

London, UK: the OTE pay range for this role is £72,000 to £99,000 per year. 

This role will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Actual On-Target Earnings (OTE) will be determined based on permissible factors such as transferable skills, work experience, market demands, and primary work location. The OTE range provided is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Hybrid Faire employees currently go into the office 3 days per week on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and a third flex day of their choosing (Monday, Wednesday, or Friday). Additionally, hybrid in-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year. Specific Workplace and Information Technology positions may require onsite attendance 5 days per week as will be indicated in the job posting. 

Why you’ll love working at Faire

  • Move fast: You'll own meaningful problems that serve customers around the globe with the agency to move fast and see your results clearly.
  • Equipped to scale: We invest in what matters, including the latest enterprise AI tools, to help you work smarter and get more out of every day.
  • Best in class: Our team is full of sharp, kind, and generous colleagues who care about their craft and about helping you grow in yours.
  • Real rewards. Competitive pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits designed to support your life inside and outside of work.
  • Belonging: We're intentional about building an environment where every Faire employee has equal access to opportunities, growth, and success.

description:
📍London / UK Remote | 💰 Engineer II £60,000 - £80,000 + Benefits | Technology - Engineering |  

About our Engineering Teams:

We have around 400 engineers across Monzo who design and build our in-house banking platform. We have big ambitions for the future, and technology plays a big role in creating a bank our customers want, so engineers at Monzo collaborate across disciplines to solve interesting challenges throughout the company.

These range from the products our customers use everyday to underlying infrastructure, security, payments and finance, customer operations, financial crime, and data, to name just a few areas. As a bank, there is scope for impact across a huge number of opportunities.

We contribute to open source software as much as possible. Our blog is a good place to learn even more about what we do!

Your day-to-day   

This role is all about collaborating with your team to make a difference to your customers. As a backend engineer you’ll work in a squad alongside other disciplines like product managers, marketers, user researchers, designers, mobile engineers, web engineers, data analysts, business analysts, writers and more! 

Together you'll build and support a particular part of Monzo. Our squads belong to our wider collectives (a word we use to describe self-governing business units of ~100 people). They are: Core Banking, Business Banking, Wealth, Borrowing, Growth, Payments, Platform, Fincrime, Security & Expansion. All of our collectives are doing innovative work, many of which have machine learning and AI at the forefront- from fighting financial crime to building smarter financial tools - and you may have the opportunity to join a collective that gives you direct exposure to this exciting space.

They’re all looking for additional Backend Engineers right now, we do a standard interview process across all our collectives and at the end we will find the best match for you based on your skills, experience, preferences and aligning with the business need! 

Our backend engineers have a variety of different backgrounds. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we’d love to talk to you. We do not ask for formal qualifications or degree requirements for any of our engineering roles.

You should apply if:

  • you have strong experience working on the backend of a technology product
  • you want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day
  • you have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions
  • you’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity
  • you’re interested in distributed systems and writing resilient software
  • you have some experience with strongly-typed languages (Go, Java, C, Scala etc.).
  • you think you’d enjoy the kind of work we’re doing

We're on the look out for L30+ Engineers at the moment, you can read more in our Engineering Progression Framework you will be interviewed across the whole framework, so if you're not sure what level you're aiming for chat to your recruiter! 

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything thats listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

What you’ll be working on: 

We hire very technically agnostic so whilst we use the below technologies we do not expect prior knowledge, you will be fully supported in our organised onboarding to get up to speed in the below: 

  • Go to write our application code (there’s an excellent interactive Go tutorial here)
  • Cassandra for most persistent data storage
  • Kafka for our asynchronous message queue
  • Kubernetes and Docker to schedule and run our services 
  • Envoy Proxy for RPC
  • AWS for most of our production infrastructure and GCP for most of our data infrastructure
  • React for our public web apps and internal tools
  • We also have physical datacenters with actual cables to connect to various third parties

The Interview Process:

Our interview process involves three main stages: 

  1. Initial Call 
  2. Take home task or pair coding exercise 
  3. Final interview: including a system design and a behavioural interview 

Our average process takes around 4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. 

You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact us on -----

One of our engineers has written a detailed blog on their experience through this process, for extra details, hints and tips please see here.

What’s in it for you:

💰 £60,000 - £80,000 base salary➕ plus stock options 

✈️We can help you relocate to the UK

description: JOB SUMMARY More in Common is looking for a Chief of Staff. This is a new role and a rare opportunity to help shape the next phase of a fast-growing global organisation working on some of the most urgent issues of our time, working at the CEO's side with a unique vantage point across our country teams, strategy and network of funders and partners worldwide. (Please note that the preferred London location is for ease of communication with Tim Dixon, who is based in the UK. The postholder will not be involved in the day-to-day polling and research activities of More in Common UK, and will not report or routinely provide support to our Executive Director in the UK, Luke Tryl.) ABOUT MORE IN COMMON More in Common is a nonprofit dedicated to understanding the dynamics of polarisation, and identifying solutions that can strengthen social cohesion and confidence in democracy. We help leaders navigate the dynamics of polarisation more effectively, find common ground and bring people together to address shared challenges. More in Common's work is frequently featured in media and used by leaders in government, nonprofits, philanthropy, education, the arts and business. We have a country-led model, with work deeply rooted in national contexts and led by country directors in each of our seven countries, with a total headcount approaching 100. Our teams generate research insights, translate them into thought leadership, and disseminate and implement them across a wide ecosystem of partners and stakeholders. We hold relationships with leaders in many sectors of society, across politics, media, business, civil society, philanthropy, culture and faith, and from national leaders to local community groups. Recent work has produced fresh insights into public attitudes on immigration, online safety, nature and the energy transition, Ukraine, and democracy. ABOUT THIS ROLE This is a rare opportunity to help shape the next phase of a fast-growing global organisation working on some of the most urgent issues of our time, working at the CEO's side with a unique vantage point across our country teams, strategy and network of funders and partners worldwide. The Chief of Staff is a new role, created as More in Common transitions from its founding phase, when the organisation was led by its co-founders, to sole CEO leadership. It incorporates a senior adviser role, in which the Chief of Staff will be the principal aide, advisor and coordinator to the global CEO Tim Dixon, ensuring priorities advance, decisions move efficiently and commitments are executed. The Chief of Staff will also act as organisational glue: working closely with More in Common’s team of country leaders and directors, ensuring alignment between country executive directors, the global team and the CEO around More in Common's strategy, programmes and operations, and helping spot and resolve problems before they escalate. RESPONSIBILITIES Strategy Strategic counsel: Trusted thought partner to the CEO on strategy and major decisions, drawing on visibility across the whole organisation and ensuring alignment within its country-led model. CEO communications: Shapes the CEO’s internal and external communications, and absorbs the coordination, communication, and follow-through work that would otherwise pull the CEO away from key public-facing responsibilities. Organisational coordination CEO workflow: Manages the CEO's priorities, time and decision pipeline with the Senior Executive Coordinator, so the right issues get attention and decisions don't stall. Team alignment and delivery: Keeps global and country teams aligned on shared priorities, facilitates decision-making across the organisation, and leads special projects requiring senior-level attention. Leadership Country ED support: Liaises with country Executive Directors on the CEO's behalf, identifying where teams need more support and providing assistance in crises. Talent and succession: Supports leadership succession planning and mentors emerging leaders across country teams. QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE We are looking for a candidate with: Commitment to More in Common’s mission and values. Experience working closely with, or in direct support of, a senior executive, founder or CEO. Exceptional organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders and time-sensitive decisions simultaneously. Sound judgement and discretion, including experience handling sensitive or confidential matters. Comfortable operating with incomplete information, and confident making calls on when to resolve issues independently versus escalate. The ability to lead through influence rather than authority, working effectively with peers and country teams who have their own mandates and priorities. Excellent written and oral communication skills, including the ability to synthesise complex information for diverse audiences. Inter-disciplinary interests and experience, such as having worked in different sectors (business, government, nonprofit), countries and roles. Fluency in English and at least one of French, German, Spanish, Polish or Portuguese languages. At least six years’ working experience in such fields as public opinion research, public policy, political science, and international relations. OTHER INFORMATION More in Common intentionally invests time, energy, and resources in nurturing a distinctive values-driven culture. This culture defines how we work together as a team and with others: Humble, ambitious and generous Rigour and excellence in everything we do Driven by the common good, not by ideology or partisanship Deep curiosity about people, and a commitment to elevating others’ views, particularly those whose voices are largely unheard Firmly rooted in each of our national contexts but curious about the world beyond Valuing diversity of thought, allowing our own beliefs to be challenged and embracing healthy disagreement Embracing a dual role as both sense-makers and change-makers Valuing courage and risk-taking Embracing learning and innovation, and always looking for new paths to make a difference Engaging others from a starting point of trust Drawing from a wide range of backgrounds, worldviews, identities and life experiences Believing in the power of a good laugh and being a great place to work. COMPENSATION AND CONDITIONS Competitive salary related to location, and excellent benefits along with generous leave and family policy Some regular international travel Personal learning budget Working in one of our country offices, with a preference for London as our CEO is most often there DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION We believe our impact can be greater if our team reflects a broad range of social and cultural backgrounds, beliefs, political persuasions and life experiences. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and are committed to building an inclusive team. DEADLINES AND HOW TO APPLY The deadline to apply is August 31, 2026. Interested candidates should include a CV and a cover letter explaining your personal reasons for wanting to work at More in Common, in this role. A strong cover letter reflects the kind of attention we try to bring to our work - original, insightful and personalised. We want to hear something that only you could tell us, without AI assistance. Bonus: experience at platforms that act as the legal reseller (Global-e, Digital River, Paddle), local acquiring outside Europe and the US, interchange and scheme fee economics, or a background in data science or quantitative consulting before payments Signals we care about: Ridiculous bias for action. About the job

Define how Graphcore tests complex hardware before it reaches production and the field.

As Principal Board Test Engineer, you will lead advanced manufacturing test strategy for complex Circuit Card Assemblies. You will shape how Graphcore improves defect coverage, diagnostic resolution and production quality.

Your work will influence products, test architectures and manufacturing partners. You will define methods, evaluation criteria and technical approaches that help PTD move faster with confidence.

You will design and direct test strategies across optical inspection, X-ray inspection, in-circuit test, boundary scan and functional test. You will turn complex issues into clear decisions for engineering, suppliers and CEM partners.

This is a senior technical role with real ownership. You will set direction, mentor engineers and help Graphcore build stronger test capability for future products.

The Team and Culture

The Product Test and Diagnosis team detects, diagnoses and manages hardware defects across chips, boards and full systems. The team works close to design, manufacturing, silicon, software and systems engineering.

Work moves through hands-on investigation, clear technical judgement and direct ownership. You will be expected to act fast, speak up and take responsibility for test strategy decisions.

Decisions are shaped by evidence, design intent and manufacturing reality. You will help the team think big, challenge assumptions and raise engineering standards across disciplines.

What we’re looking for

· Deep expertise in manufacturing test for advanced, high-complexity Circuit Card Assemblies.
· Strong knowledge of electronics fundamentals, CCA manufacturing processes and defect mechanisms.
· Expertise in JTAG 1149.x boundary scan, iJTAG and embedded or processor-controlled functional test.
· Experience architecting, programming and debugging bed-of-nails MDA/ICT and board-level test systems.

Comfortable using data and product performance metrics to support prioritisation and decision-making. Experience with product and project management tools such as JIRA. description:
About the job

Build the cloud platform that puts Graphcore AI systems into real use.

As a Senior Cloud Engineer, you will develop and operate private cloud services for Graphcore teams and users. You will turn product and user requirements into reliable, deployed services.

Your work will support large-scale AI systems built from Graphcore hardware, high-performance servers, networks and storage. These systems help engineers validate, benchmark and optimise the platforms behind advanced AI compute.

You will use Infrastructure-as-Code, observability and automation to deploy, test and improve cloud infrastructure. You will also work with datacentre, software and product teams to keep critical systems performing.

This is hands-on engineering with real ownership. You will often work with pre-release hardware and software, where judgement and pace matter.

 

The team and culture

The Cloud Platform Team builds the systems that give internal users and customers access to Graphcore AI infrastructure. Work moves from requirements to deployed services, with engineers close to the users and systems they support.

You will work across Software Platform, Datacentre Operations and Product Development. Decisions are shaped by technical evidence, user needs and the realities of operating critical infrastructure.

This team suits engineers who take responsibility, speak up and move quickly. You will be trusted to work independently, solve hard platform problems and keep services available.

 

What we’re looking for

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in a relevant subject.
  • Solid software engineering or IT experience, with proven delivery as an individual contributor.
  • Experience managing on-premises or private-cloud environments.
  • Strong Linux scripting and system administration skills across bash, Python, awk, sed, Ubuntu, RHEL and variants.
  • Experience with Git, CI pipelines and Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform/OpenTofu, Ansible or Packer.
  • Hands-on understanding of cloud services, virtualisation, networks, storage, monitoring and observability.

While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. If you meet most of our essential criteria, we encourage you to submit an application and showcase how your background makes you a strong candidate.

 

Benefits


· Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work
· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension
· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success
· Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day
· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones
· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover
· Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.
We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.

 

Sponsorship
Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.

 

Join the Team at Graphcore
Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  

Location: Our office is located in Oxford, England (UK), with hybrid working

The Role: 

We are looking for a Senior Electronics Engineer to join our Reliability Engineering team at IonQ. In this role, you will be responsible for finding, root-causing, and permanently resolving electronics  and control hardware issues on our operational trapped-ion quantum computers, contributing to the team's mission of improving fleet uptime and driving down the operational cost of our commercial and development systems.

You'll play an important part in owning the full lifecycle of electrical reliability fixes — from identifying a real-world bottleneck through to standardizing the resulting fix into every future build — working closely with Operations, Science, Manufacturing, and Engineering to keep our quantum systems running reliably and effectively. 

Responsibilities:

In this position, you will work on root-causing, designing, and deploying electronics system design fixes across our fleet of quantum systems, supporting the effective delivery of reliable, development and production hardware. You'll have the opportunity to drive system upgrades, standardize control and drive electronics across systems, and build the observability that catches problems before they cause downtime, contributing directly to the success of the Reliability Engineering team.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Triage & root cause: Actively monitor, root-cause, and prioritize electrical, control-system, and drive-electronics issues on live systems based on severity and impact to uptime and performance.
  • Solution development: Design, prototype, build, and test electrical fixes — spanning schematic capture, PCB layout, and board- and system-level test — taking solutions from concept through to permanent integration.
  • Reliability upgrade leadership: Drive electrical workstreams for major fleet-wide upgrades (e.g. control-hardware consolidation, drive-electronics standardization, remote telemetry/monitoring for laser and system health) to reduce variance and downtime across systems.
  • Retrofitting & deployment: Coordinate directly with Operations and Science teams to schedule, deploy, and retrofit upgrades onto live systems while managing operational constraints, and verify fixes improve system performance, reliability or operability. 
  • Documentation & standardization: Feed validated fixes back into engineering documentation, build manifests, and the Engineering Change Request (ECR) process so every improvement is baked into the baseline for all future builds.

To be successful, you will need strong foundations in analogue, RF, and mixed-signal electronics design, experience with the Altium PCB toolset, familiarity with RF concepts and confidence working directly on operational hardware under time pressure. We're looking for someone who can translate a system-level reliability problem into a concrete engineering solution, work across Operations, Science, and Engineering to get it deployed safely, and document it so it sticks. You'd be a great fit with:

  • Analogue and mixed-signal electronics: strong practical experience designing and debugging op-amp circuits, low-noise amplifiers, filters, ADC/DAC modules, grounding, shielding and common digital interfaces. 
  • Altium design control and documentation: strong experience managing evolving schematics and PCB designs in Altium, producing clear technical documentation, and establishing effective review, ERC/DRC, release and change-control processes. 
  • Fault-finding and electrical integration: able to diagnose power supplies, analogue circuits and control electronics, and develop reliable PCBs, adapters, connectors, breakout cables and harnesses. 
  • Stakeholder engagement and delivery: able to gather requirements, explain technical issues and trade-offs across different disciplines, and take solutions through testing, deployment and documentation. 
  • Bonus: familiarity with LVDS and FPGA-based control electronics, cryogenic or RF/microwave systems, and Python-based test automation or telemetry.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

 

Senior Medical Writer 

Our Senior Medical Writers are responsible for driving day-to-day project delivery (with support from others) within an account in order to create outstanding medical content across a variety of therapy areas. This position is ideal for an experienced writer who has a passion for scientific and medical developments, a keen interest in AI, and who enjoys tackling new problems, interacting with clients, and mentoring internal team members.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Scientific knowledge:
    • Confidently steps into new therapeutic areas
    • Starting to lead discussions with clients and external experts on therapy area, drivers which influence treatment decision-making and patient pathways
  • Strategic knowledge: Helps to lead meetings and strategic discussions with clients
  • AI
    • Proactively utilizes a broad range of AI solutions to streamline complex projects, with support from others
    • Evaluates and implements AI-driven solutions to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of projects, identifying opportunities for improvement and collaborating with team members to optimize project delivery
    • Provides guidance and training to team members on best practice
  • Project ownership:
    • Leads content delivery for complex projects with supervision from senior team, delegating to AMW/MWs as needed and where appropriate to ensure timely execution to a high standard
    • Skilled in achieving communications objectives by employing a broad range of channels and formats
  • Project development:
    • Interrogates briefs from clients/internal teams and proactively flags any queries or potential issues
    • Applies critical thinking skills towards a project brief to achieve deliverables in a timely and efficient manner
    • Provides a proactive, solution-focused approach towards resolving queries, and addressing feedback
    • Initiates discussions with Account Teams regarding potential barriers to successful project completion that may arise
  • Editorial:
    • Develops compelling narratives from complex information
    • Structures and writes novel projects that may not have been executed previously
  • Quality control:
    • Takes responsibility for overall quality of deliverables with supervision from senior team
    • Reviews JMWs’ work for adherence to brief, client objectives and quality of writing, providing constructive feedback
  • On site: Leads elements of the on-site programme across a variety of events with support from others
  • Client liaison: Leads scientific discussion with clients and external experts as appropriate to capture briefs, resolve queries, and progress scientific content development in timely and efficient manner
  • Growth and new business
    • Supports development of scientific content for new therapeutic areas for new business
    • Proactively identifies new business opportunities with new and existing clients
  • Project management: Provides timely and accurate communication to accounts team on writer hours, and project progress
  • Teamwork: Trains/mentors junior writers on account-specific therapy area knowledge and processes

Qualifications and skills

  • You should bring a strong scientific background with a degree in a scientific or medical discipline (post-graduate degree preferred). A high level of academic achievement is expected
  • You should bring previous experience of medical writing at an MW level or above
  • A passion for, and profound understanding of, healthcare, science, medicine, and the pharmaceutical industry is essential, as well as a keen interest in AI technologies
  • You’ll need to be personable, articulate, and capable of nurturing relationships. Previous experience mentoring MWs and interacting regularly with clients is essential

 

What Real Chemistry offers

Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefit program and perks. Learn more about our great benefits and perks at: http://www.realchemistry.com/

Our Real Hybrid and Regional Teams (Real HART) approach is designed to foster collaboration, learning, innovation, and meaningful relationships while providing flexibility where appropriate. Because our workforce spans multiple countries, regions, and client needs, work arrangements may vary by role and location. Some positions offer hybrid or remote flexibility, while others require regular in-office presence. For example, certain teams and regions, including some of our UK operations, have office-based requirements. description:
Who We Are

VML is a leading creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce, creating connected brands to drive growth. VML is celebrated for its innovative and award-winning human-first work for clients including AstraZeneca, Colgate-Palmolive, Dell, Ford, Microsoft, Nestlé, The Coca-Cola Company, and Wendy's. In 2026, VML was named Campaign’s Global Network of the Year and ranked #2 Creative Network of the Year at Cannes Lions. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore. 

VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. 

For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

About the job

At VML Live, we inspire growth for ambitious brands through sport and entertainment. For more than 25 years, we’ve made it our mission to engage audiences across the world’s biggest sports, major competitions, and bespoke experiences. We work solely for brands, and we are rights-holder agnostic, meaning that we won’t compromise on driving the best results and ROI for our clients through their sport and entertainment partnerships.

 

We are a close-knit, collaborative team with a unique and vibrant culture. Clients value our creativity, our innovative thinking and our strategic, insight-based approach to every challenge. With our HQ in London with offices in other key worldwide locations, we are proud to be part of the Wunderman Thompson global network, and a WPP Group agency.

 

This role provides an exciting opportunity to join a large WPP agency team managing global activation and content for a major F1 team partner brand.

 

We’re looking for a driven Senior Partnership Manager to play a lead role in liaising with the F1 team, other WPP agencies, our client’s global brand team and our client’s central partnership team, as we work to support them in delivering their partnership activation plans with best-in-class project management.

 

Based at our office, Sea Containers in Blackfriars, the Senior Partnership Manager will work within a five person immediate Brand team which sits within a wider client team of 14. This is a client facing role, with line management responsibilities, which provides extensive autonomy and significant opportunity for growth.

 

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Act as a key senior member of the account management team with the confidence, knowledge and experience to guide the client with a solutions-driven focus
  • Day to day responsibility for development and delivery of complex creative content projects, all with the aim of bringing to life our client’s F1 partnership for their key target audiences
  • Take the lead in working closely with the brand team, regional/end market clients and relevant internal teams to ensure all activation plans are proactively delivered to a high standard with full approval of the F1 team and internal client stakeholders as required
  • Manage, influence, and maintain a productive partnership with the core client, their regions and end markets.
  • Work across multiple projects with seamless efficiency
  • Develop and maintain a strong working relationship with the F1 team to foster a collective culture of creativity, problem solving and positivity
  • Possess outstanding project management skills and a high level of organisation
  • Coordinating and collaborating with cross-discipline team members to make sure that all parties are on track with project requirements, deadlines, and schedules
  • Support the Account Director with regular client and F1 team reporting
  • Expand our current business relationships by identifying and securing growth opportunities as part of the dedicated projects and across the wider business
  • Maintain an awareness of best practice in sponsorship activation to fully maximise the potential of market activation plans

 

 

KEY REQUIREMENTS

  • Extensive experience of managing complex and creative content projects
  • Appropriate years of account management experience, preferably working within F1 or with another major sports sponsor and their markets on a global basis
  • Experience in working to tight deadlines as well as successfully managing complex client finance, briefs and proposals
  • Proven ability to juggle multiple work streams, stakeholders and projects with a flexible attitude
  • International mindset with the ability to operate in global regions seamlessly when required
  • Confident communicator with experience of successfully managing client expectation
  • Enthusiasm, energy and an innovative approach to the role
  • Agile mindset and ability to pivot as project requirements change
  • Resilient and forward thinking in nature
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with impeccable attention to detail
  • Strong team player with a positive attitude and desire to grow both personally and professionally as the role requires
  • Demonstrate the ability to generate creative ideas that make our current and prospective clients sit up and notice
  • A willingness to travel both inside and outside of the UK as may be required from time to time
  • Ability to write and speak a leading foreign language, whilst not essential, would be beneficial
  • A passion for entertainment, culture, and sport is highly sought after

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP (VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

description:
Location: hybrid, based at one of our UK offices: London, Cardiff, or Manchester. 

The Role

As a key member of the Global People Operations team, the UK People Operations Coordinator provides end-to-end operational HR support across a diverse UK portfolio. The role has primary employee-lifecycle ownership for Strategy & Communications, People Advisory and Corporate Functions, and coordinates onboarding and offboarding activities for Financial Advisory and Management Consulting. As a first point of contact for employees and managers, the role holder manages a broad range of enquiries, transactions and cases, applying sound judgement, resilience and a strong service mindset. The successful candidate will be a proactive self-starter with HR generalist experience who can build effective stakeholder relationships, manage competing priorities and identify opportunities to simplify and improve how services are delivered. 

Responsibilities 

  • Own and manage the employee lifecycle for Strategy & Communications, People Advisory and Corporate Functions, including onboarding, probation, family leave, absence and wellbeing cases, Visa and immigration, job and contractual changes, internal transfers and offboarding. 
  • Coordinate onboarding and offboarding for Financial Advisory and Management Consulting, ensuring candidates, employees, managers and relevant internal teams understand responsibilities, deadlines and next steps. 
  • Manage business-specific onboarding and offboarding requirements, including different contractual and compensation terms, templates, approvals and downstream actions, while identifying opportunities to align and simplify processes. 
  • Act as a first point of contact for employees and managers, independently resolving a broad range of routine and moderately complex people-related queries. Promote and educate stakeholders on available self-service tools, resources and processes, while providing additional guidance and support where required. Exercise sound judgement in identifying and appropriately escalating sensitive, high-risk or specialist matters to the relevant People Team colleagues.
  • Manage employment changes such as promotions, salary and allowance changes, flexible working arrangements, changes to hours or location, and internal and international transfers, ensuring documentation, approvals and Workday records are complete and accurate. 
  • Prepare contractor agreements and coordinate contractor onboarding and offboarding in Workday. Conduct appropriate checks to support the correct engagement and classification of contingent workers, guide managers through the completion of CEST assessments where required.
  • Provide support, both to employees and the wider People Team, during cyclical process such as Goal Setting, and Performance, Promotion and Compensation reviews. Such support varies by process but may involve leading training sessions for employees, providing Workday assistance, or tracking completion rates.
  • Monitor case queues, lifecycle trackers and deadlines, proactively managing workload, identifying risks and providing clear updates to stakeholders. 
  • Collaborate with Payroll, Reward, HRIS, Recruitment, IT and other internal teams to ensure accurate and timely delivery of employee-lifecycle processes. Route benefits queries to the Reward team and provide operational support where agreed. 
  • Serve as a front-end subject matter expert for Workday and a confident back-end user, providing practical guidance, resolving issues, completing transactions and maintaining high standards of data quality. 
  • Anticipate reporting needs and work with HRIS and other stakeholders to improve reporting, data quality and management information. 
  • Build effective cover arrangements and share knowledge across the UK People Operations team to strengthen resilience during peak periods and absences. 
  • Handle personal and confidential information with integrity, discretion and appropriate data-protection controls. 
  • Proactively contribute to the continuous improvement of HR policies, processes and related documentation/guides to enhance People Operations services and the employee experience.

Requirements

  • At least 2 years’ experience as an HR Generalist
  • Knowledge of local employment legislation.
  • Experience with HRIS systems like Workday preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree in human resources, business management, psychology or CIPD Level 3 or 5 qualification is highly regarded
  • Strong administration and organizational skills with excellent attention to detail
  • Exceptional customer service and prioritization skills
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Exemplifies integrity and discretion
  • Continuous improvement mindset – a proactive, adaptable, and agile collaborator.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)

What We Can Offer

  • Competitive salary (depending on experience)
  • 28 days holiday
  • Discretionary bonus
  • Annual salary review
  • Pension (with company contribution: 5% of annual salary)
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity leave (depending on length of service) and shared parental leave
  • Private medical insurance
  • Group Income protection
  • Life assurance
  • Cycle to work schemes
  • Season ticket loans
  • Regular social, cultural and charitable activities
  • Flexible working with office laptop and phone provided

 

About Teneo

Teneo is the global CEO advisory firm. We partner with our clients globally to do great things for a better future.

Drawing upon our global team and expansive network of senior advisors, we provide advisory services across our five business segments on a stand-alone or fully integrated basis to help our clients solve complex business challenges. Our clients include a significant number of the Fortune 100 and FTSE 100, as well as other corporations, financial institutions and organizations.

Our full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial transactions and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organizational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs, corporate governance and ESG.

The firm has more than 2,000 employees located in 50+ offices around the world.

The Platform Collective builds and maintains the infrastructure, tools and processes that sets the rest of Monzo technology teams up for success. We work on a wide range of shared infrastructure, services and engineer tooling.

Über Verve Retail Media

Der fehlende Wirkungsnachweis ist das größte Problem im stationären Handel für Werbungtreibende. Obwohl Marken Millionen in Werbung am Point of Sale investieren, können sie nicht belegen, ob daraus Käufe wurden.

Verve Retail Media (VRM) löst dieses Problem. Wir vermarkten und betreiben digitale Werbe-Screens in mehreren tausend LEH-, Drogerie- und Convenience-Standorten und verbinden sie mit digitalen Coupons, Retargeting im CTV und anderen Offsite-Kanälen. Marken buchen bei uns keine isolierten Werbeformate, sondern 360-Grad-Kampagnen, die zu Hause starten und bis zum Einkaufsregal reichen - eine Closed-Loop-Messung auf Basis realer Kassendaten.

VRM ist die eigenständige Retail Media Unit der börsennotierten Verve Group SE. Wir arbeiten wie ein schnell skalierendes Startup mit AI-First-Strategie über alle Funktionen und mit Zugriff auf die Infrastruktur eines internationalen AdTech-Unternehmens mit über einer Billionen ausgelieferter Werbeimpressionen pro Jahr. Was du verkaufst

  • Kampagnen, die zu mehr Abverkauf und Kategorie-Relevanz führen
  • Konkrete Beweispunkte aus vielen tausenden acardo Kampagnen

An wen du verkaufst

  • Direkt an FMCG-Marken
  • Die Ansprechpartner kommen meist aus dem Trade Marketing oder Category Management

Deine Aufgaben

  • Eigene Pipeline aufbauen, entwickeln, priorisieren und mit belastbarem Forecast führen

Du passt zu uns, wenn du aus einer der folgenden Richtungen kommst und mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung mitbringst:

Deshalb beherrschst du die Sprache „Abverkauf / Wirkungsnachweis / Kategorie-Relevanz" – also genau das Herzstück unseres Versprechens.

Profil 4: Loyalty-/CRM-/Couponing-Plattformen, die in FMCG-Trade-Budgets verkaufen. Dein zuhause war bisher bei Payback, DeutschlandCard und ähnlichen CRM Anbietern. Warum diese Rolle

Bewerbungsprozess

Schick deinen Lebenslauf zusammen mit einer kurzen Arbeitsprobe (max. 1 Seite). Wähle eine reale Situation: einen Deal gegen Widerstände gewonnen, eine Kundenbeziehung von Null aufgebaut, ein neues Konzept mit messbarem Ergebnis oder ein kommerzielles Problem, das du gelöst hast. Was wir verstehen wollen:

  • Was war das Problem? Nicht der Kontext. Das tatsächliche Problem.
  • Was hast du getan? Nicht das Team. Was hast du entschieden, gebaut oder verändert?
  • Was war das messbare Ergebnis? Umsatz, Conversion, Kundenbindung. Sei konkret.
  • Was würdest du heute anders machen?

Schreib es wie ein Memo, das dein CEO in 3 Minuten lesen kann. Ohne Füllmaterial. Die Arbeitsprobe ersetzt das Anschreiben.

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

At Ping Identity, we believe the best user experiences are designed through exploration, iteration, and hands-on prototyping. We’re looking for a Senior UX Design Developer who thrives at the intersection of design and code—someone equally comfortable designing experiences and bringing them to life in code.

You’ll use code as a design tool—not simply as an implementation medium—to explore ideas, validate interactions, and shape product direction.   • Prototype interactive user experiences in code to explore, communicate, and validate ideas.

  • Partner with engineering throughout development to ensure designs are implemented with exceptional quality and attention to detail.

  • Balance user needs, accessibility requirements, technical constraints, and business goals.

  • Provide constructive design feedback and mentor other designers through critique and collaboration.

  • Bachelor’s degree in UX Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Computer Science, or a related field—or equivalent professional experience.
  • 4+ years of experience in UX design, frontend development, or a hybrid design/development role.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating both thoughtful UX design and interactive coded prototypes.
  • Expert proficiency with modern UX design tools and component-based design systems.
  • Experience building interactive applications using React, Vue, or similar modern frontend frameworks.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, CSS, responsive design, and frontend best practices.
  • Experience using code as a prototyping medium—not just for production implementation.
  • Experience working with component-based design systems and frontend component libraries.
  • Solid understanding of accessibility standards and WCAG guidelines.
  • Excellent interaction design skills and attention to visual detail.
  • Ability to communicate design decisions and technical tradeoffs effectively with designers, engineers, and product managers.
  • Experience using AI-native tools and workflows to accelerate design, prototyping, or frontend development.
  • Curiosity about emerging interaction patterns for AI-powered products and experiences.

Identity is foundational to digital security and trust. At Ping Identity, you’ll help create products that enable organizations around the world to securely connect people, applications, and devices.

description:
Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.

The Architecture team at Tenstorrent is designing the central compute chiplet that powers our next generation automotive SoC. This role is about turning real world automotive and safety requirements into architecture that performs, scales, and ships fast and reliably. If you think silicon design should start with clarity and end with confidence, this is where your experience makes the biggest impact.

This role is remote, based in Munich, Germany.

We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.

 

Who You Are

  • Approach design with a systems mindset, always thinking in trade offs, not just specs and block diagrams.
  • Bring deep knowledge of SoC architecture, from interconnects and I/O to memory and CPUs.
  • Confident working within performance, power, and reliability constraints.
  • Familiar with, or eager to dive into, functional safety, ISO 26262, and automotive grade design challenges.

 

What We Need

  • Someone to architect and specify one or more chiplets in the robotics and automotive family.
  • 5+ years of experience translating high level requirements into detailed architectural direction.
  • Ability to identify impactful features that boost PPA, safety, and reliability, without adding unnecessary complexity.
  • Willingness to collaborate across design, verification, software, and systems teams to keep execution moving.

 

What You Will Learn

  • What it takes to architect a chiplet based SoC for automotive applications.
  • How functional safety and reliability shape every design decision.
  • How to integrate complex IP blocks and CPU subsystems into a coherent, shippable product.
  • Why silicon architecture is a cross functional discipline, not just a collection of isolated blocks.

 

Tenstorrent offers a highly competitive compensation package and benefits, and we are an equal opportunity employer.

This offer of employment is contingent upon the applicant being eligible to access U.S. export-controlled technology.  Due to U.S. export laws, including those codified in the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), the Company is required to ensure compliance with these laws when transferring technology to nationals of certain countries (such as EAR Country Groups D:1, E1, and E2).   These requirements apply to persons located in the U.S. and all countries outside the U.S.  As the position offered will have direct and/or indirect access to information, systems, or technologies subject to these laws, the offer may be contingent upon your citizenship/permanent residency status or ability to obtain prior license approval from the U.S. Commerce Department or applicable federal agency.  If employment is not possible due to U.S. export laws, any offer of employment will be rescinded.

Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Group Overview

The Digital and Synthetic Capability Unit (D&S) is committed to providing mission-driven information solutions that seamlessly bridge the digital and physical realms. Leveraging cutting-edge technologies and advanced platforms, we empower operational readiness and elevate situational awareness across diverse domains—including air, maritime, and space.

Position Summary

As our Deployed Test Engineer (Systems Integration & Test Engineer – Deployed Mission Systems), you will help ensure that our software systems, integrated with aircraft hardware, work correctly in real-world environments. You will support the deployment, testing, and validation of our systems on aircraft, working closely with engineering teams and customers. This role does not involve permanent deployment to site, when not deployed you will be an active member of the Software QA team to help deepen your understanding of the Product. 

This is a hands-on role that combines software testing, system integration, and on-site support. You will work hands-on with real systems, travel to interesting locations, and develop both technical and communication skills. 

What You'll Do

  • Assist in installing and updating software on aircraft and test systems 
  • Record and maintain test evidence and deployment notes, including test results, defects, and system configurations, to support engineering teams and customer reporting
  • Support system-level testing in real environments (including aircraft reference systems and simulators) 
  • Seek feedback and continuously improve technical and on‑site working practices 
  • Help ensure the system meets functional and performance requirements 
  • Capture clear and actionable defect reports, including steps to reproduce, logs, and environmental details 
  • Work with senior Engineers to help resolve issues found during testing or deployment 
  • Work alongside customers and internal teams during deployments and testing 
  • Communicate clearly and professionally, especially during on-site activities 

What You Bring

  • Basic understanding of software systems and integration concepts 
  • Background in and passion for Software QA & Testing 
  • Attention to detail and willingness to follow structured processes 
  • Good at thinking on your feet and adapting to new situations 
  • Degree or equivalent in Software, Systems, Electrical, Aerospace Engineering, or similar 
  • Systematic and proactive approach to problem-solving 
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills 
  • Willingness and enthusiasm to travel regularly (including international travel) 
  • Basic knowledge of networking (IP, connectivity, troubleshooting)  

Additional Eligibility Qualifications

  • Background within avionics  
  • Exposure to hardware-software integration testing 
  • Knowledge with project management tools such as Azure DevOps or Jira 

Benefits

  • Private Medical Insurance  
  • Subsided gym membership / plans through Wellhub  
  • Electric Car scheme  
  • Cycle to work scheme  
  • Salary sacrificed pension scheme  
  • Free lunch on office days

  • Bonus Scheme  
  • Personal development opportunities 

Work Authorization / Security Clearance

The employee will have the legal right to work in the UK and will be able to produce right to work documentation.  

AAP/EEO Statement

Metrea Mission Data (MMD) is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or other characteristics protected by law

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time position with typical working hours of Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. 

Work Environment

This job operates in a hybrid office setting (typically 3 days a week in our London OR Harwell office, up to the employee) & and test sites 

Travel

Travel is required in this role.

Our Firmware

At Metrea, our single core value is Rooted in Humility, and our four cornerstone attributes are Entrepreneurial, Systematic, Discerning, and Over-Deliver. These form what we call our Teammate Firmware. Just like technical firmware connects software and hardware, our Firmware is the constant interface between our mission and our people. It defines how we show up, how we work together, and how we solve complex problems.

Our team Firmware creates a web-like, hyper-collaborative, dynamically hierarchical way of working that helps us adapt quickly, communicate openly, and distribute decision-making to where expertise actually lives. It enables groups to self-organize around hard problems, shift fluidly as priorities evolve, and operate with the trust, curiosity, and discipline required in a complex mission space. This foundation allows us to deliver elegant, effective solutions and uphold our purpose: protecting our precious inheritance.

You manage planning, capacities, dependencies, and releases and keep the entire development process in view. You lead our Development Leads and development teams both functionally and disciplinarily. You establish clear responsibilities, develop team members, and ensure that problems and blockers are identified and resolved early. You coordinate teams and tickets throughout their full lifecycle, continuously improve our development and project processes, and ensure transparent and realistic planning for all relevant stakeholders. You are the central interface between Engineering and Product Management. Product owns product strategy, prioritization, and requirements; together with the Development Leads, you ensure these are translated into technically sound, realistically planned, and reliably delivered solutions. This is not a traditional IT project management role: you bring a strong technical background yourself and can make architecture and design decisions together with our Development Leads, assess technical risks, and evaluate different solution approaches. Alongside short-term delivery, you also keep long-term technical topics in view, including architecture, maintainability, security, technical debt, and the continuous improvement of our engineering standards. You actively drive our AI First Development Culture. This goes far beyond AI-assisted coding: you identify opportunities to integrate AI into research, technical conception, architecture, project planning, development, testing, reviews, debugging, documentation, and other development processes, and help the team use these tools effectively. Your profile You have at least 5 years of relevant professional experience in or around software development and have worked hands-on as a software developer yourself. You bring proven experience leading developers and development teams and have already held both functional and disciplinary leadership responsibility. You have experience managing software development projects: you have coordinated multiple developers and stakeholders, owned planning and timelines, managed dependencies, and guided releases through to delivery. You are technically deep enough to understand and shape architecture decisions, identify technical risks early, and discuss technical topics with experienced developers at eye level. You bring strong experience in at least one of our technology areas: Python-based backend development, ideally with Django / Django REST Framework or FastAPI, or modern frontend development with React and TypeScript. Experience with the other area is a plus. You understand modern SaaS architectures, REST APIs, relational databases, and the core challenges involved in developing, operating, and evolving complex web applications. You can balance product requirements, technical possibilities, and available resources and communicate decisions transparently and convincingly. You already use AI tools actively or are deeply engaged with how AI can change development and project processes. You evaluate new tools pragmatically, critically assess their output, and can establish successful workflows across the team. You communicate clearly and convincingly and are equally comfortable coordinating with Engineering, Product Management, and senior management. You bring a collaborative leadership style, strong organizational skills, and a genuine desire to shape and improve how we work. You are fluent in German and English. In addition to working from home, you value in-person exchange with colleagues and the sense of being part of a team. Why us? At Athereon GRC, we develop smart software that advances companies, organizations, and institutions across the private sector, public sector, and social services in the areas of information security and compliance. As an agile and fast-growing company, we combine technological excellence with a genuine hands-on mentality – here, your contribution truly matters. Bring your expertise and personality to our team – we're looking for people who are passionate about IT, think outside the box, and are eager to take on responsibility. Our client portfolio ranges from global market leaders and hidden champions to innovative mid-sized companies across a wide variety of industries – so it's guaranteed never to get boring. Als HSE-Team bei Isar Aerospace sorgen wir dafür, dass alle gesetzlichen Vorgaben zum Arbeits-, Gesundheits- und Umweltschutz eingehalten werden. Wir entwickeln geeignete Sicherheitskonzepte, bieten bei Bedarf Schulungen an und behalten potenzielle Risiken im Blick, um unser Team bestmöglich zu unterstützen und gemeinsam verantwortungsvoll zu wachsen.

Deine Rolle in unserer Space Mission: 

  • Mitwirkung an spannenden (auch internationalen) Projekten

  • Administrative Aufgaben rund um Sicherheit & Gesundheit
    • Koordiniere die Bereitstellung von Sicherheitsausrüstung, unterstütze bei Erste-Hilfe-Maßnahmen und halte unsere Dokumentation aktuell
  • Mitarbeit an Gesundheitsförderungsprojekten & Networking
    • Engagiere dich in Projekten zur Förderung von Gesundheit am Arbeitsplatz und tausche dich mit internen sowie externen Partnern aus.
  • Organisation von Schulungen & Trainings
    • Plane und unterstütze bei der Durchführung von Workshops und Unterweisungen, damit das Team immer up to date bleibt
  • Gestaltung eines positiven und sicheren Arbeitsumfelds
    • Setze dich dafür ein, dass sich alle wohlfühlen und sicher arbeiten können
  • Kreative Content-Erstellung & digitales HSE-Handbuch
    • Erstelle Präsentationen und Postings zu aktuellen Themen und entwickle unser digitales HSE-Handbuch weiter
  • Vor-Ort-Kontrollen und operative Einsätze 
    • Übernehme praktische Aufgaben auf dem Betriebsgelände, z.B. durch Aushänge, Fotodokumentationen oder Sicherheitsbegehungen
  • Erstellung von Schulungsunterlagen
    • Entwickle interne Präsentationen zu HSE-Themen und bringe eigene Ideen ein
  • Eigene Projekte nach Interesse
    • Nutze die Chance, eigene Ideen z.B. zu Ergonomie, Notfallplänen oder Brandschutz einzubringen und eigenverantwortlich umzusetzen

Qualifikationscheckliste

  • Du bist aktuell im Bachelor- oder Masterstudium eingeschrieben
  • Du hast bereits erste praktische Erfahrungen gesammelt – zum Beispiel durch Praktika, Nebenjobs oder Tätigkeiten bei der Feuerwehr, dem THW oder im Rettungswesen
  • Du gehst sicher mit Office365 um; Erfahrung mit Confluence oder ähnlichen Tools ist ein Plus
  • Du bist kommunikativ, gehst offen auf andere zu und hast ein gutes Gespür für die Anliegen deiner KollegInnen rund um HSE-Themen
  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Du bist sowohl am Schreibtisch als auch direkt vor Ort gerne mit dabei
  • Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch fließend und kannst dich in beiden Sprachen sicher austauschen
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und selbstständig, bringst Engagement und Eigeninitiative mit
  • Teamgeist, Zuverlässigkeit und Flexibilität runden dein Profil ab

Benefits: 

  • Subventioniertes Mittagessen: Bleibe jeden Tag mit köstlichen, subventionierten Mittagessen energiegeladen

  • Sports Club Mitgliedschaft: Bleibe fit mit unserer gesponserten Sports Club Mitgliedschaft (EGYM Wellpass) 
  • Und vieles mehr! Entdecke zusätzliche Vorteile und Vergünstigungen, wenn du Teil unseres Teams wirst. 

Wer wir sind

Isar Aerospace ist Vorreiter der New Space Industrie mit dem Ziel einen besseren, schnelleren und kostengünstigeren Zugang zum Weltraum zu ermöglichen.

Unsere Mission ist es, zur Demokratisierung des Weltraums beizutragen, um das Leben auf der Erde heute und für zukünftige Generationen zu verbessern.

Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes Unternehmen mit dem Ziel, nachhaltige und umweltfreundliche Startmöglichkeiten für kleine und mittlere Satelliten und Konstellationen in die niedrige Erdumlaufbahn zu liefern. Das Unternehmen wird von weltweit führenden Technologieinvestoren mit starkem Engagement und großer Unterstützung privat finanziert.

Unser Team besteht aus engagierten und talentierten Mitarbeitern mit Leidenschaft für Innovationen im Weltraum. Wir bauen revolutionäre Raketen, die die Raumfahrtindustrie nachhaltig verändern werden.

Teams worldwide rely on us to stay up. To keep it that way, we are building an internal red team that continuously tests our own products the way a real attacker would. And we're a genuinely interesting target: an attacker who silences ilert doesn't just steal data — they turn off the alarm while they work. As a working student on our red team, you help us find, prove, and get security issues fixed in our own systems. You learn to think like an attacker, working closely with our team. You don't need to arrive as a finished pentester. You need curiosity, a habit of taking things apart to understand them, and the care to handle what you find responsibly. Tasks Test Our Apps and APIs: Hunt for vulnerabilities in our web and mobile apps and APIs — from authentication and access control (IDOR) to injection, misconfigurations, and exposed secrets. Re-test Past Findings: Go back over findings from previous penetration tests and verify the fixes actually hold. Automate Security Checks in CI: Help build secret, dependency, and code scanning into our pipelines so issues surface early instead of late. Review New Features Before They Ship: Support security reviews as features are being built, not after. Run Authorized Social Engineering: Design and run phishing and pretexting exercises against our own team — always under a written scope signed off by the CTO beforehand, always debriefed as a learning exercise, never punitive. Then help us fix what the exercise exposed. Poke at the AI: We're building an AI SRE that investigates incidents and can execute actions on approval. Prompt injection, tool abuse, and agent-boundary testing are wide-open ground. Document and Follow Through: Write up findings clearly and reproducibly, then follow them through to a fix. description: Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things—so we did. We built many relationships while developing products that were thoughtful, effective, and genuinely useful. But, since then, we’ve grown… and so has our ambition. Now, we’re entering our next chapter—defined by applied AI. AI is a powerful force in the end-to-end software development cycle, and we’re creating practices that allow us to deliver software fast and more effectively than traditional approaches, creating meaningful value for our partners. Today, our builder mindset is driving us to become an AI-native organization across every function. We’re still evolving, and that’s part of the opportunity. If you want to build, learn, and tackle challenges alongside an ambitious team, let’s build together. This position is 100% remote within LatAm. What you’ll be doing We are seeking someone who views the Knowledge Graph not just as a database, but as a living organism that requires constant care, feeding, and pruning. You understand that a RAG system is only as good as the data underlying it. You are intrigued by the complexity of ingesting massive, messy datasets and transforming them into clean, connected knowledge. In short, someone who likes: Architecting Graph ETL: Designing and developing robust ETL pipelines specifically for graph ingestion. You aren't just dumping rows into tables; you are determining how disparate data sources connect, evolve, and relate in a graph structure. Data Ingestion at Scale: Managing high-volume data streams using tools like Kafka and implementing CDC (Change Data Capture) patterns to ensure the graph reflects real-time reality. Automated Graph Hygiene: Writing scripts and jobs for deduplication, orphan node detection, and data consistency checks. You take pride in a clean schema. Modeling Time: Handling complex temporal relationships (e.g., how property ownership or financial status changes over time) within the graph. Performance Tuning: Ensuring that as the graph grows (25k+ reports and beyond), the underlying query performance remains snappy through optimizing indexes and storage. What we’re looking for We want to work with people who have a passion for collaborating with their teams, building software while nurturing inclusive and respectful relationships with their coworkers. With the ones that are open about their shortcomings and what they do not know now, but remain eager to keep on growing and closing those gaps. Ideally, they would also have: Neo4j Expertise (Must Have):4+ years of hands-on experience. You master Cypher, schema design, and the operational side of managing a production graph. ETL & Pipeline Mastery: Strong background in building data pipelines. You know how to take raw data, clean it, and structure it for graph ingestion. Streaming & CDC: Familiarity with event streaming platforms like Kafka and Change Data Capture methodologies to sync operational databases with the graph. Python Proficiency: Strong Python skills for writing ingestion scripts, maintenance jobs, and custom graph algorithms. Data Integrity Focus: Experience implementing automated jobs for entity resolution, deduplication, and quality assurance. Nice-to-Have: C# Knowledge: Ability to read or contribute to C# codebases. Domain Experience: Prior work in Finance or Real Estate sectors. Able is powered by curious, thoughtful people who care about what they build and how they build it. We’re actively investing in our team through AI training, knowledge-sharing, and hands-on experimentation to ensure everyone grows alongside the technology. This position is 100% remote within LatAm. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English are a requirement. As a team member, you can expect: To work 40 hours per week, and be available during normal business hours as needed Payments made in USD 18 days of PTO per year, observance of local holidays, and an annual break between Christmas and New Years A monthly wellness stipend and snack boxes delivered to your home About Able Able builds technology products in a portfolio model. We believe that people, teams, and processes are more important than the ideas themselves, so we’ve focused on bringing great people together, and investing in their growth. We’ve built products in a variety of industries. Everything from media to finance to toys to healthcare. Sometimes we work with management teams to help their businesses grow faster or unlock value using technology. Other times we start or buy businesses outright. Each time, we look for opportunities to leverage technology built at the portfolio-level to drive value faster. Able is committed to inclusion and diversity and is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is but the beginning of a conversation we’d love to have with you. Apply, and let’s get this adventure started! Originally posted on Himalayas
